notes: The merged v0.1.33 release passed the reviewed single-node-4c4g cloud staging path end to end in GitHub Actions run 33777258980, including administrator prerequisites, Alembic/checkpointer migration, immutable image rollout, version 3 Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B probe and reindex, readiness, authenticated upload-to-Agent business smoke, document ACL governance, audit retention/legal-hold governance, identity-binding lifecycle, sanitized evidence and workload restoration. The release record and hashes are reconciled in evidence/m6/20260904-v0.1.33-staging-governance.json. Three earlier attempts remain recorded as strict failures: a GHCR cold-pull timeout at migration, a fail-closed stale migration Job guard, and an expired short-lived smoke token; the fixed memberships were revalidated and all smoke/governance tokens were rotated in memory without persistence or log output before the final pass. M6-R2 and M6-R4 are closed. PostgreSQL/R2 recovery, rollback and measured-objective evidence remain valid, while M6-R5 stays open solely for the explicitly deferred independent fault-domain drill and reviewer sign-off. The Free qwen3-embedding-8b challenger remains intentionally deferred; GPU/vLLM and production-capacity claims remain outside this single-node release. M5/M7 real-provider repeatability, representative-corpus, cost/revision, human-review and managed-observability gates remain open.
